messages.subject: For Paul Griffiths | Aviation infrastructure, government partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Dubai Airports PR Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Paul Griffiths, Chief Executive Officer.

Dubai Airports' aviation-infrastructure and growth agenda requires disciplined alignment across government, aviation authorities, security agencies, infrastructure partners and operating teams. That interface is highly relevant to the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities in a complex operating environment.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and stakeholder strategy might support Dubai Airports' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Dubai Airports.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
